findings.suggestion: 11 short units; distinguish complete sentences, dialogue and deliberate emphasis before editing.
findings.why: Several very short units may interrupt the argument.
findings.fix: Check which units are complete sentences and which fragments need connection.
findings.keep_when: Keep dialogue, slogans, instructions and deliberate emphasis.

findings.sentence: What a testament to their leadership and inspiration, as well as to the partnership forged between school and community.
findings.why: Generic significance does not explain the effect on the reader.
findings.fix: Use a supplied consequence, or cut the unsupported praise.
findings.keep_when: Keep significance supported by specific evidence in context.

findings.suggestion: Short-unit annotation; a complete short sentence or a deliberate fragment can be appropriate.
findings.why: A short unit may be a complete sentence, dialogue or emphasis; length alone cannot decide.
findings.fix: Treat this as an annotation. Read surrounding units before changing it.
findings.keep_when: Keep complete short sentences, dialogue and a single punchy fragment.

An editing prompt; absence is meaningful only when the check completed and was not suppressed.
Three sentence lengths within ±3 words are a reading prompt; headings and lists are excluded.
A digit-bearing token is a checkable-detail prompt, not verification of a claim.
Name actual evidence; this check cannot verify sources.
Retain contrasts that clarify a distinction.
confirm every name, number and source is the writer's own

Confirm that changes in tone fit the purpose and audience.
